text.arabic_uthmani: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ

words.gloss_range: Form IV imperfect causative insertion of night into day
words.root_gloss_range: entry through a threshold, narrowed here to caused temporal insertion

words.prose: {{ar:يُولِجُ}} ({{tr:yūliju}}) opens with ongoing Form IV causation: night is not merely arriving, it is made to enter day as an object into a domain. The root image of threshold-entry and the repeated formulaic pairing with night and day (3:27, 22:61, 31:29, 57:6) make the first proof an enacted boundary crossing before {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) is named.

topics.headline: caused threshold entry
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ordinary nightfall is presented as caused entry across a boundary before the actor is named.
topics.reason: QAC grammar gives Form IV imperfect transitive force, and the CRITICAL rows converge on ongoing caused insertion, threshold imagery, opening position, and the later exact reprise.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative night as the caused object of entry
words.root_gloss_range: night as the dark temporal interval, treated here as a movable whole

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّيْلَ}} ({{tr:al-layla}}) is the definite accusative object of the first insertion. Darkness is not a vague absence here; it is the recognizable night-regime made movable, and its later return as {{ar:ٱلَّيْلِ}} ({{tr:al-layli}}) closes the reciprocal frame.

topics.headline: night as governed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that night is treated as a definite whole moved under command, then later returned as a receiving domain.
topics.reason: The rows align around accusative objecthood, definite wholeness, sensory darkness, night-first ordering, and role reversal with the later genitive form.

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) completes the first entry frame by attaching to {{ar:يُولِجُ}} ({{tr:yūliju}}) and governing {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:al-nahāri}}). With an entry verb, the preposition keeps its locative force while also making day the target reached by the caused night-entry.

topics.headline: entry-domain marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first temporal movement has a target domain, not just a general alternation.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence and CRITICAL rows agree that the phrase belongs to the entry verb and scopes the receiving domain rather than the whole clause.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارِ}} ({{tr:al-nahāri}}) is genitive after {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}), so day first receives night as a known daylight domain. Its openness and river-channel undertone make the receiving side feel like an extended course, preparing the later running language, while the later accusative {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارَ}} ({{tr:al-nahāra}}) shows that this apparent stability is also governed.

topics.headline: day as receiving course
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that daylight first appears as a governed container before it becomes the acted object in the reverse clause.
topics.reason: The row family preserves genitive domain role, definite identity, the openness or channel pressure of the root, and the later case reversal.

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the second {{ar:يُولِجُ}} ({{tr:yūliju}}) clause to the first as a matching counterpart. It coordinates a full finite clause without forcing simple chronology, so the two movements function as one reciprocal proof.

topics.headline: reverse clause link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the second insertion is a coordinated counterpart, not a separate proof.
topics.reason: The rows consistently treat the particle as coordination between two complete mirrored insertion clauses.

words.prose: The second {{ar:يُولِجُ}} ({{tr:yūliju}}) repeats the same Form IV imperfect and reverses the roles: {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارَ}} ({{tr:al-nahāra}}) becomes object and {{ar:ٱلَّيْلِ}} ({{tr:al-layli}}) becomes domain. The exact reprise forms a night-day, day-night chiasm in which neither side owns the cycle.

topics.headline: repeated causative reversal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same causative verb governs both directions, making reciprocity grammatical rather than decorative.
topics.reason: QAC grammar confirms the reversed object-domain frame, and the CRITICAL rows emphasize exact verbal repetition, shared hidden actor, causative force, and chiasm.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative day as the reversed caused object
words.root_gloss_range: daylight and open visibility, here made an affected temporal body
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّهَارَ}} ({{tr:al-nahāra}}) reverses the earlier genitive role of day and becomes the direct object of the second entry verb. The visible regime of daylight is therefore not autonomous; it is acted upon with the same governed status as night.

topics.headline: day as governed object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that visible daytime is grammatically humbled by becoming the affected object just like night.
topics.reason: The rows converge on accusative objecthood, preserved definite identity, visible-day semantics, role reversal, and preparation for the sun-moon proof.

words.prose: The second {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) repeats the same prepositional work, now governing {{ar:ٱلَّيْلِ}} ({{tr:al-layli}}). That repetition makes night the reverse receiving interior and keeps reciprocity audible in syntax, not only in meaning.

topics.headline: reverse domain marker
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the reverse clause keeps the same object-plus-domain architecture.
topics.reason: The rows all attach the preposition to the second entry verb and treat it as preserving the construction while the roles exchange.

words.gloss_range: definite genitive night as the final receiving domain
words.root_gloss_range: night as an enclosing dark interval, narrowed here to the governed container for daylight
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّيْلِ}} ({{tr:al-layli}}) closes the insertion beat as a definite genitive domain. Night began as the object made to enter, and it ends as the container into which day is routed, giving the temporal proof a cyclic envelope before the ayah turns to the sun and moon.

topics.headline: night closes the cycle
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that night frames the first beat by moving from acted object to enclosing domain.
topics.reason: The rows support genitive containment, definite continuity with the earlier night, sensory enclosing force, formulaic recurrence (3:27, 57:6), and beat closure.

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) carries the same implied actor forward while pivoting from reciprocal temporal entry to {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}). The aspect changes from imperfect cycles to a perfect act of subjection, but the conjunction keeps both as accumulated evidence of governance.

topics.headline: pivot to celestial bodies
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proof accumulates from time cycles into the bodies that mark them.
topics.reason: The rows treat the connector as coordinating a new divine act under the same proof-frame, with no required chronological sequencing.

words.gloss_range: Form II perfect of imposed service over sun and moon
words.root_gloss_range: subjection and harnessing selected locally; the ridicule branch is blocked by the cosmic objects

words.prose: {{ar:سَخَّرَ}} ({{tr:sakhkhara}}) is a perfect Form II verb governing both {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:al-shamsa}}) and {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرَ}} ({{tr:al-qamara}}). The root is narrowed here to imposed service, not ridicule, and the doubled stem makes the luminaries appear as powers pressed into assigned order; the same governance formula appears with sun and moon elsewhere (14:33, 31:29).

topics.headline: settled cosmic subjection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sun and moon are not merely present in order; they are harnessed into service by a settled act.
topics.reason: The cosmic objects block the mockery branch and select service-subjection, while the rows preserve the perfect aspect, Form II intensity, paired objects, formula recurrence, sound pressure, and transition from cycles to mechanisms.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّمْسَ}} ({{tr:al-shamsa}}) stands as the definite accusative object of subjection. Its light, heat, and daytime prominence are real, but the syntax places the known sun under harness before {{ar:كُلٌّۭ}} ({{tr:kullun}}) distributes motion to each luminary.

topics.headline: sun under subjection
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the brightest visible power is made an object before it can be mistaken for sovereignty.
topics.reason: The rows support objecthood, definite singular reference, solar prominence, subjection rather than autonomy, and later individualization through the running clause.

The pair shares a single subjection frame, while the visible coordination preserves two members for the following distributive {{ar:كُلٌّۭ}} ({{tr:kullun}}).

topics.headline: paired object link
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moon shares the same governing act while remaining distinct enough for individual motion.
topics.reason: The rows treat the coordinator as sharing the same governor and case relation while preserving the pair distinction.

words.gloss_range: definite accusative moon as the second object of subjection
words.root_gloss_range: lunar visibility and measure, narrowed here to the governed moon
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَمَرَ}} ({{tr:al-qamara}}) completes the coordinated object pair as a definite governed body. Its phases and night-marking role make it a measurer, but the phrase soon gives each luminary an appointed term, so the measuring body is itself measured.

topics.headline: moon measured under command
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the moon, itself a measure of time, is also measured by an appointed term.
topics.reason: The rows converge on accusative objecthood, concrete lunar reference, lunar measure, sun-moon formula recurrence, and the immediate move from shared subjection to distributed running.

words.gloss_range: indefinite nominative quantifier resuming the pair distributively

words.prose: {{ar:كُلٌّۭ}} ({{tr:kullun}}) resumes the sun-moon pair as a nominative subject and distributes {{ar:يَجْرِى}} ({{tr:yajri}}) to each one. Total order is built from individually bounded courses, matching celestial-motion formulas such as 21:33 while here being specialized by the appointed term.

topics.headline: distributed eachness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that shared subjection does not erase each luminary's individual assigned course.
topics.reason: The rows preserve nominative resumption, distributive force with a singular verb, totality imagery, and the pivot from governed objects to bounded actors.

words.gloss_range: singular imperfect running for each luminary toward a term

words.prose: {{ar:يَجْرِى}} ({{tr:yajri}}) is singular after distributive {{ar:كُلٌّۭ}} ({{tr:kullun}}), so each body runs its own course. The flow image is transferred to celestial motion, and the following {{ar:لِأَجَلٍۢ}} ({{tr:li-ajalin}}) answers the endpoint implied by that motion; comparable bounded-motion formulas appear at 31:29, 39:5, 13:2, and 36:38.

topics.headline: bounded running course
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that celestial motion is pictured as a course that raises the question of its endpoint.
topics.reason: The rows support singular distributive agreement, intransitive course-motion, flow imagery, endpoint complementation, and the structural delay of the limit phrase.

words.prose: {{ar:لِ}} ({{tr:li}}) attaches the running to {{ar:أَجَلٍۢ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}). The preposition can carry several values elsewhere, but this local pairing narrows it toward endpoint, limit, and allotment: motion is pictured first, then governed duration is supplied.

topics.headline: endpoint lām
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the running is oriented toward a bounded term rather than left as indefinite continuation.
topics.reason: The rows explicitly narrow the particle from broader lām functions to endpoint force after the running verb and before the term noun.

words.gloss_range: indefinite term or deadline qualified by a named specification

words.prose: {{ar:أَجَلٍۢ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}) gives the running a real term, while its indefiniteness keeps that term undisclosed to listeners. The following {{ar:مُّسَمًّۭى}} ({{tr:musamman}}) prevents the indefiniteness from becoming randomness: the endpoint is unknown at the surface but fixed in governance, as term language is elsewhere applied to human decree and cosmic order (6:2, 31:29, 39:5, 13:2).

topics.headline: real undisclosed term
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that cosmic regularity is finite and appointed even though its date is not disclosed to the audience.
topics.reason: The rows align on indefiniteness plus specification, deadline semantics, delayed but fixed duration, cosmic collocation, and closure of the sun-moon motion beat.

words.gloss_range: passive participle qualifying the term as designated

words.prose: {{ar:مُّسَمًّۭى}} ({{tr:musamman}}) agrees with {{ar:أَجَلٍۢ}} ({{tr:ajalin}}), so designation belongs to the endpoint itself. The naming and marking pressures are kept within the passive participle: the term is specified, but the appointer and the date are not displayed in the compact phrase.

topics.headline: designated endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the endpoint is named or marked in governance, even though the namer and date remain unstated.
topics.reason: The topic is narrowed because root and derivational disputes color designation but local grammar selects a Form II passive participle modifying the term, not an independent sky or height sense.

words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكُمُ}} ({{tr:dhālikumu}}) gathers the night-day and sun-moon governance just described and points it toward the listeners. The plural suffix makes the proof addressed, preparing the chain through {{ar:رَبُّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbukum}}) and {{ar:تَدْعُونَ}} ({{tr:tadʿūna}}).

topics.headline: demonstrative identification hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cosmic proof is gathered and pointed at the audience before the divine name is stated.
topics.reason: The rows support demonstrative definiteness, addressee suffix force, the central hinge from signs to identification, and the direct-address chain.

words.gloss_range: nominative proper divine name identifying the demonstrative referent

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) supplies the identity of {{ar:ذَٰلِكُمُ}} ({{tr:dhālikumu}}). The form is a proper name, not a generic deity label, and the surrounding words test that name by lordship, dominion, and rival invocation rather than by mere sacred address.

topics.headline: proper-name identification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the cosmic governor is identified by the proper divine name before the relationship to the audience is explained.
topics.reason: The topic is narrowed because derivational disputes around the divine name remain background pressure; locally QAC and the rows select nominative proper-name identification before relational lordship.

words.gloss_range: construct lordship title with plural addressee suffix

words.prose: {{ar:رَبُّكُمْ}} ({{tr:rabbukum}}) turns the named divine referent toward the audience through construct lordship and the plural suffix. The title combines mastery, ownership, nurture, and management, so the governed cosmos becomes evidence concerning the listeners' own Lord rather than an abstract ruler.

topics.headline: addressed lordship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that cosmic governance is made personally accountable as your Lord, not left as distant power.
topics.reason: The rows align on idāfa suffix force, r-b-b management and nurture range, apposition after the divine name, corpus identity formula, and repeated addressee accountability.

words.prose: {{ar:لَهُ}} ({{tr:lahu}}) comes first in the possession clause, assigning the ownership relation to Him before {{ar:ٱلْمُلْكُ}} ({{tr:al-mulku}}) appears. In context this fronting creates exclusive pressure, because the same ownership field will soon be negated for the invoked others.

topics.headline: fronted exclusive possession
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that possession is assigned to Him before the category of dominion is even named.
topics.reason: The rows preserve predicate fronting, possessive lām with divine pronoun, contrastive exclusivity, and the scale relation between full dominion and later non-possession.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُلْكُ}} ({{tr:al-mulku}}) names dominion as the definite whole category, not a share among claimants. The m-l-k range joins owning, ruling, and controlling, and the later {{ar:يَمْلِكُونَ}} ({{tr:yamlikūna}}) repeats the same field under negation; 67:1 gives a related dominion formula, while 35:13 sets total rule against membrane-scale non-possession.

topics.headline: total dominion category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that dominion is stated as a whole category before the ayah collapses rival ownership to less than a membrane.
topics.reason: The rows support definite abstract dominion, ownership-rule range, delayed subject grammar, same-root contrast with the later verb, and the positive-before-negative scale collapse.

topics.headline: contrastive resumption
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rival clause is the direct foil to divine dominion, not an unrelated afterthought.
topics.reason: The rows agree that the conjunction starts a new rival-possession clause and gains adversative force from the following negated predicate.

The rivals are not introduced by proven titles; their identity is parasitic on the audience's invocation, and only then does {{ar:مَا يَمْلِكُونَ}} ({{tr:mā yamlikūna}}) judge their capacity.

topics.headline: relative identity through invocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the rivals are identified by human calling before any capacity is assessed.
topics.reason: The rows support definite relative-pronoun subjecthood, dependence on the following ṣila, delayed possession verdict, and identification through invocation rather than demonstrated power.

The following {{ar:مِن دُونِهِۦ}} ({{tr:min dūnihi}}) narrows the call into rival invocation rather than ordinary calling, and the qirāʾah contrast with third-person report changes discourse angle without changing the ownership denial; 35:14 then tests whether the invoked beings hear or answer.

topics.headline: habitual rival invocation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah records an ongoing practice of calling apart from Him before exposing the called beings as powerless.
topics.reason: The topic is narrowed because the d-ʿ-w range includes ordinary calling, summoning, and claiming-related branches, but local syntax and the apart-from phrase select habitual rival invocation; accepted qirāʾah evidence is kept as discourse contrast.

Together with {{ar:مِن قِطْمِيرٍ}} ({{tr:min qiṭmīrin}}), it turns a tiny object into a total zero-ownership test and mirrors the earlier positive dominion clause.

words.prose: {{ar:يَمْلِكُونَ}} ({{tr:yamlikūna}}) keeps the m-l-k firm ownership grip alive only to empty it under negation. The plural verb gathers the invoked beings collectively, yet the object shrinks to a singular {{ar:قِطْمِيرٍ}} ({{tr:qiṭmīrin}}); the same root that gave {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:Allāhu}}) {{ar:ٱلْمُلْكُ}} ({{tr:al-mulku}}) now denies rivals even minimal control, sharpening broader no-benefit formulas such as 13:16 and 34:22.

topics.headline: collective non-ownership
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the many invoked beings are gathered only to have every register of ownership denied at the smallest scale.
topics.reason: The rows preserve transitivity under negation, plural subject reference, ownership-control range, imperfect standing capacity, minimal object scale, and same-root antithesis with the dominion noun.

words.prose: {{ar:قِطْمِيرٍ}} ({{tr:qiṭmīrin}}) is the genitive indefinite object after the negating {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}): any date-stone membrane at all. Its thin outer-film image distinguishes it from other tiny date-anatomy terms, and its checklist hapax marking makes the final image sharply singular. The ayah collapses scale from night, day, sun, moon, term, and dominion to a boundary-skin the rivals still cannot own; the tiny-date register is also visible at 4:49, while 35:14 carries the incapacity forward into failed response.

topics.headline: date-stone membrane collapse
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah ends by shrinking from cosmic governance to a tactile date-stone film that rivals still cannot own.
topics.reason: The rows support the grammar after negating min, the tactile outer-film sense, contrast with related minimality terms, final-position scale collapse, sound texture, hapax specificity, and next-ayah continuation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled causative verb in words 1 and 5, with night and day exchanging object and container positions.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same act is reversed across the two clauses: night enters day, then day enters night. Insertion, darkness, and daylight-opening make the boundary bidirectional, so each phase can grow inside the other without the pair losing its contrast.

activation_trace.role: Literal insertion supplies the reciprocal crossing and makes each temporal phase alternately entrant and host.
Night and its darkness supply one member of the contrast whose extent can penetrate the other.
Daylight as an opening of brightness supplies the counter-domain and gives the exchange a light-dark boundary.

changed_reading.before: Night simply follows day and day follows night in a binary sequence.
changed_reading.after: Night and day are reciprocally inserted domains with a moving, permeable boundary; succession includes overlap and transfer, not only replacement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sun and moon are subjected, each runs, and the running is bounded by a designated term in words 9-15.
baseline_models.mechanism: Subjection converts celestial motion from autonomous behavior into assigned service. The distributive each gives the two bodies distinct courses, while running, temporal limit, and naming make every course both kinetic and bounded by a known designation.

activation_trace.role: Directed subjection supplies service under command rather than self-originating celestial power.
The solar disk and its light identify the first visible bearer of the assigned motion.
The moon and its light identify the second bearer, preserving two courses rather than one fused luminary.
Encompassing totality lets each member have its course while both remain inside one complete order.
Flowing motion supplies continuous transit rather than a static celestial display.
A fixed temporal limit gives the running a terminal bound.
Naming and designation make the limit specified rather than an indefinite fading-out.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon merely move until some remote end.
changed_reading.after: Each luminary performs an individually assigned, continuously running service whose endpoint is already designated.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The turn from 'your Lord, His is sovereignty' to the called alternatives owning no date-stone membrane in words 17-28.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah moves from cosmic administration to a minimum-unit audit. Lordship joins command to maintenance, sovereignty joins rule to actual possession, and the alternatives addressed by human calling fail the test at the thinnest material scale.

activation_trace.role: Lordship supplies ownership, mastery, and obeyed authority as the identity behind the cosmic acts.
Repair and staged completion add maintenance to rule, connecting Lordship to the preceding ordered processes.
Sovereignty supplies the maximal jurisdiction asserted for God.
Concrete possession turns the repeated root into an operational comparison between God's rule and the alternatives' incapacity.
Directed calling supplies the human attempt to reach or enlist an alternative source of agency.
Otherness and lower rank mark the invoked figures as outside the asserted source of sovereignty.
The date-stone's fine membrane supplies the deliberately minute possession test that closes the argument.

changed_reading.before: The ending is a generic assertion that God is king and other gods are powerless.
changed_reading.after: The ending audits sovereignty as maintained order plus real disposal: the cosmic governor passes at the largest scale, while invoked alternatives fail even at a seed's membrane.

context_deltas.mechanism: Opening, holding, and releasing provide a gate vocabulary; dispatching wind, stirring cloud, and driving it onward provide a routed causal chain. Together they revise the focus's ingress and subjection into regulated circulation: entry is admitted, movement is energized and directed, and flow can be restrained.

activation_trace.role: Reciprocal insertion is the focus operation re-read as controlled passage through a boundary.
Directed service anchors the claim that the circulation is governed rather than spontaneous.
The opening of a closed access supplies the enabling gate in the circulation model.
Holding and confinement supply the complementary capacity to stop or retain what might flow.
Release and dispatch supply outward movement once access is granted.
Wind supplies the mobile medium that begins the packet's explicit atmospheric transport chain.
Stirring something from its place supplies activation between dispatch and transport.
The drawn-along cloud supplies a body carried through the routed process.
Driving supplies the directional arrow that takes the mobile body toward its assigned destination.

structural_cues: 35:2 balances opening against holding and negates every counter-agent in parallel clauses.
35:9 orders dispatch, stirring, cloud formation, driving, and revival as a causal sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gate, restraint, release, and routed transport; I infer that the same control grammar governs the focus's temporal ingress and celestial service. A live alternative is that these are separate signs linked only by divine agency, not one circulation mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Day-night alternation and celestial motion are observable cycles that display power.
changed_reading.after: The cycles behave like actively gated and routed flows: admission, restraint, release, excitation, and directional service are coordinated operations.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promised appointment, measured lifespan, binding record, and the exact return of the named term in the closing ayah move the focus phrase beyond astronomical scheduling. A named term is also protected time: conduct accumulates during deferment, then the jurisdictional limit arrives.

activation_trace.role: Continuous running supplies the interval whose endpoint receives ethical and temporal content from context.
The fixed limit anchors every contextual expansion of the focus's term.
Designation makes the endpoint particular and knowable to its appointing authority.
An appointment bounded by time or place gives the earlier promise a scheduled horizon.
Life extended through time supplies the human-scale duration that can be allotted.
Loss of part of a duration supplies the counter-operation by which an allotment can be shortened.
A recorded determination with binding force turns duration into an administered allotment.
Taking to account for wrongdoing supplies the judgment that is presently deferred.
Acquired gain supplies the human conduct accumulated during the interval.
The repeated fixed limit directly transfers the focus phrase into the surah's closing account of delay and arrival.
The repeated designation confirms that the deferred endpoint is appointed, not accidental.

structural_cues: 35:11 places extension and diminution of lifespan inside a written determination.
35:45 repeats the focus's term-plus-designation construction, then follows it with the term's arrival.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an appointed promise, recorded lifespans, earned conduct, and an exact phrase-level recurrence at 35:45; I infer a shared grammar of bounded trajectories and accountable delay. The live alternative is that celestial and human terms are parallel appointments without sharing the same ethical function.

changed_reading.before: The designated term is only the expiration point of the sun and moon's motion.
changed_reading.after: The designated term is a surah-wide jurisdictional boundary: courses and lives run within allotted time, and deferment leaves room for conduct before reckoning arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calling changes direction across the context: an enemy recruits a party, humans call alternatives that neither hear nor answer, and a burdened person calls for help but cannot transfer any load even to kin. The focus's ownership denial therefore becomes a network test: address or affiliation cannot manufacture reception, response, possession, or transferable capacity.

activation_trace.role: Calling supplies the attempted relation whose practical capacity is tested by the surrounding episodes.
Actual possession is the focus criterion that a merely verbal relation cannot create.
The minute membrane fixes the zero-capacity endpoint of the test.
A call that inclines hearers supplies the opposite direction: the supposed outside power is itself recruiting humans.
A group bound around a position supplies the social product of successful recruitment.
The repeated call supplies the attempted communication whose channel is then negated.
Auditory reception supplies the first missing capacity of the invoked alternatives.
Answering speech supplies the second missing capacity, response after reception.
The burdened person's appeal supplies a concrete request for capacity transfer.
A heavy burden supplies what one agent cannot shift to another.
Load-induced heaviness intensifies the need that motivates the appeal.
Bearing responsibility supplies the specific transfer that the grammar refuses.
Kinship supplies the strongest ordinary social tie, yet even it cannot make the transfer effective.

structural_cues: The subject of calling reverses between 35:6 and 35:13-14: the recruiter calls humans before humans call the powerless alternatives.
35:18 pairs an explicit appeal with repeated passive negation of carrying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recruitment, failed hearing, failed response, and failed burden transfer; I infer that the focus tests an entire claimed agency relation rather than possession alone. A live alternative is that the episodes are separate admonitions sharing only the ordinary verb of calling.

changed_reading.before: Calling an alternative is an isolated act of mistaken prayer to an ownerless object.
changed_reading.after: Calling exposes a failed capacity network: affiliation may recruit the caller, but it cannot give the called party ownership, reception, response, or power to carry another's load.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding pair of seas remains unequal and materially different, yet both support extraction and traversal. That pattern disciplines the focus's reciprocal ingress: sharing a process or boundary need not fuse identities, and movement across contrasted domains need not make them equivalent.

activation_trace.role: Mutual insertion supplies contact and overlap between the contrasted temporal domains.
Dark night remains one identifiable side of the relation despite entering day.
Opened daylight remains the contrasting side despite entering night.
Explicit comparison and denied equality prevent shared function from becoming sameness.
Two expansive bodies of water supply the adjacent material analogy for contrasted domains.
Fresh water supplies one persistent material character in the unequal pair.
Salinity supplies the other persistent material character, keeping difference concrete.
A vessel moving in water supplies traversal within a domain without erasing the domain's properties.
Cutting water by a ship supplies boundary-crossing motion that preserves rather than homogenizes the medium.

structural_cues: 35:12 places a denied equality before a coordinated list of benefits drawn from both seas.
35:19-22 later repeat denied equality across paired contrasts, cautioning against reading contact as equivalence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an adjacent unequal-but-jointly-traversed pair; I infer that it constrains how reciprocal ingress is pictured in the focus. A live alternative is that the sea comparison concerns resources only and does not govern the physics or symbolism of night and day.

changed_reading.before: If night enters day and day enters night, their identities blur into a blended continuum.
changed_reading.after: Reciprocal ingress is differentiated coexistence: boundaries move and domains overlap, while night and day remain non-equivalent members of the pair.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later inheritance of the Book and human succession on earth qualify the focus's denial of possession. The denied capacity is autonomous or rival sovereignty; the surah can still describe entrusted, inherited, and successor agency that originates in a prior giver.

activation_trace.role: Possession supplies the focus category that must be distinguished from later transferred trusts.
Rival otherness marks the target of denial as an alternative to God, not every dependent agent.
Transmission of a Book or knowledge as inheritance supplies a real but derivative trust.
The written object identifies what is passed on rather than autonomously produced by the inheritors.
One party coming after and standing in another's place supplies delegated succession on earth.

structural_cues: 35:32 makes God the grammatical giver of the inherited Book.
35:39 makes God the grammatical maker of the human successors and immediately attaches consequences to their choices.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies explicit inheritance and succession after sole sovereignty; I infer a distinction between dependent stewardship and rival ownership. A live alternative is that inheritance and succession name honor or sequence without defining a theory of delegated possession.

changed_reading.before: The focus's ownership denial can sound like a denial of all meaningful creaturely agency.
changed_reading.after: It denies autonomous rival capacity while leaving room for accountable agency that is bestowed, inherited, and held in succession.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later near-repetition expands the date-membrane verdict into a warrant audit. A claimed partner would need productive authorship on earth, an actual share in heaven, or documentary authorization; when all three fail, only mutually circulated deceptive promises remain.

activation_trace.role: Concrete possession is the compact criterion unpacked by the later interrogative tests.
The fine membrane supplies the focus's compressed negative verdict before the later grounds are enumerated.
The repeated act of calling identifies the same claimed relationship under examination.
The repeated outside-other relation identifies the same alternatives as in the focus.
Partnership supplies the legal claim that would require a demonstrable share.
Origination supplies the first possible warrant: independent productive authorship.
A binding written determination supplies the third possible warrant: granted authorization.
A clarifying statement or sign supplies the evidence that such authorization would need to contain.
Promise supplies the unsupported speech that remains after material and documentary warrants fail.
A glittering but unstable deception classifies the residual promises as appearance without title.

structural_cues: 35:40 repeats the focus's calling-from-apart construction before a three-stage interrogative sequence.
The sequence moves from earthly production to heavenly share to written evidence, then contrasts all three with deceptive promise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three denied grounds and a deceptive remainder; I infer that they unpack what real possession in 35:13 would require. A live alternative is that 35:40 is an independent polemic rather than a formal expansion of the membrane-scale test.

changed_reading.before: Owning no membrane is a vivid but largely rhetorical statement of smallness.
changed_reading.after: It is the summary verdict of a failed title audit: no creation, no share, no authorization, and therefore no more than unsupported promise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later image of holding heaven and earth against displacement specifies what sovereignty does while the focus's bodies run: it preserves system coherence. Motion and mutual ingress are not instability because the same authority that directs movement also prevents structural departure, with no fallback holder.

activation_trace.role: Directed subjection supplies controlled motion within the maintained system.
Continuous flow supplies the movement that must remain coherent rather than fly apart.
Strength and cohesion expose a material dimension of the focus's sovereignty vocabulary.
Holding and restraint supply active support against cosmic displacement.
Departure from place or state supplies the failure mode continuously prevented.
Exhaustive negation removes every substitute holder and makes maintenance exclusive.

structural_cues: 35:41 encloses possible cosmic displacement inside a counterfactual and then denies any holder after God.
The focus places sovereignty immediately after moving boundaries and running bodies, inviting a maintenance reading rather than a static throne image.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies moving focus elements and a later anti-displacement act; I infer that cohesion is the enabling condition of their ordered motion. A live alternative is that 35:41 answers catastrophic collapse only, not the ordinary operation described in 35:13.

changed_reading.before: Sovereignty is authority over a cosmic system that already remains stable.
changed_reading.after: Sovereignty is the ongoing work that lets a moving system remain one system: direction and anti-collapse are complementary acts.

context_deltas.mechanism: A running way that admits neither substitution nor transformation, followed by travel to inspect historical outcomes, activates the method branch of the focus's running. The celestial course becomes a visible instance of dependable process, while human history has its own traversable course and terminal consequences.

activation_trace.role: A customary running way supplies the focus anchor for reading motion as regular process.
A temporal bound gives every running process an outcome horizon.
A way that runs and is followed supplies the context's explicit regular-process vocabulary.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the denied mode of substitution.
Change from one state to another supplies the denied mode of transformation.
Travel and forward movement turn historical pattern into a path that can be inspected.
The last part and outcome supply the historical analogue to a course reaching its term.

structural_cues: 35:43 repeats the same governing way three times and pairs it with two future negations.
35:44 immediately converts the pattern claim into an instruction to travel, inspect, and compare outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a running-way branch, denied alteration, and observable historical outcomes; I infer an analogy between celestial regularity and historical process. A live alternative is that physical course and historical norm remain distinct even though both are dependable.

changed_reading.before: Each luminary's running is only movement along an astronomical track.
changed_reading.after: Its running also displays the surah's grammar of dependable courses: processes follow stable ways and arrive at outcomes rather than being replaced ad hoc.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant L-J-J resolution of the focus verb and imports a water-domain analogy. It remains anchored in the supplied split mapping, the focus's river branch for day, and the adjacent two-seas scene. Downstream prose should present it as an imagistic pressure or 'as if' model, never as a replacement lexical gloss for the primary W-L-J insertion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated ingress verb, its supplied L-J-J split, and the river-capable N-H-R inventory.

activation_trace.role: Open-sea depth and agitation supply a turbulent medium for picturing reciprocal ingress.
Intermixed dense darkness supplies a way for night to thicken inside rather than merely replace day.
A watercourse cutting ground gives day a current-like channel in the cross-domain image.
The adjacent wide waters activate the confluence analogy without supplying its directional claim.
Back-and-forth disturbed waves add oscillation to the image of a moving night-day boundary.

changed_reading.before: Night and day exchange fixed quantities like two blocks on a calendar.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they can be pictured as unequal currents meeting at a turbulent moving confluence where darkness thickens and recedes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it follows the packet's D-Ayn-Ayn resolution toward forceful pushing rather than the ordinary call. It remains anchored in the exact focus root, the same root's contextual use for recruitment, and the resulting party. Downstream prose should mark it as a social-force resonance, not claim that the focus verb literally means violent shoving.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's act of calling alternatives and the supplied non-dominant mapped root for that occurrence.

activation_trace.role: Forceful pushing supplies an exploratory pressure-image inside the focus's alternative-directed allegiance.
The same split branch makes the enemy's recruiting call feel like pressure that drives adherents toward an end.
A faction gathered around a view supplies the social body produced by the pressured call.
Ignited fire supplies the destructive destination toward which the recruited party is driven.

changed_reading.before: The invoked alternatives passively receive mistaken prayers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, alternative allegiance is a pressure circuit: the supposed object of appeal belongs to a recruiting system that pushes callers into a faction and toward its outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The cross-scale link is surprising because no explicit statement equates a temporal boundary with a seed membrane. It remains valid as a focus-anchored compositional observation: the ayah opens with reciprocal boundary penetration and closes with the finest named biological covering, while later fruit imagery reactivates that small scale. Downstream prose should call this a scale analogy, not an asserted symbol for the membrane.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The opening ingress construction and the closing date-stone membrane within the same ayah.

activation_trace.role: Insertion into another interior supplies the large-scale boundary operation at the ayah's opening.
The date-stone's thin covering supplies the smallest-scale boundary named at the close.
Ripened fruit reactivates the biological scale on which the closing membrane belongs.

changed_reading.before: The date-stone membrane is only a proverbial tiny object appended to a cosmic proof.
changed_reading.after: The ayah can also be seen as a scale test of boundary governance, from the moving interface of night and day down to the skin around a seed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is odd because it activates a secondary provision branch of J-R-Y with the later trade-and-recompense sequence. It remains anchored in the focus's running verb and packet-supplied branch, while the non-perishing trade, full payment, increase, and gift form a coherent contextual activator. Downstream prose should render it as an economic resonance of celestial service, not substitute 'provides' for 'runs.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's singular running verb and its supplied continuous-provision branch.

activation_trace.role: Uninterrupted provision and giving supply the latent economic valence within continuous running.
Trade seeking gain supplies the later economic frame that activates the provision branch.
Negated ruin supplies continuity and prevents the exchange from terminating in loss.
Full completion without deficiency supplies exact settlement of the running account.
Recompense for work supplies what is paid through the account.
Growth beyond the settled amount supplies surplus rather than mere equivalence.
Gift and beneficence identify the surplus as bestowed provision.

changed_reading.before: The luminaries' running is purely kinematic.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, their continuous service also resonates as an uninterrupted provision stream that runs to a term within a larger economy of exact payment and surplus gift.

strongest_changes: Reciprocal day-night ingress became regulated circulation rather than passive alternation.
The named celestial term expanded into allotted lifespan and accountable deferment through the exact recurrence at 35:45.
Calling alternatives became a capacity-network test involving recruitment, failed reception, failed response, and failed burden transfer.
The membrane-scale ownership denial was unpacked as a failed audit of creation, partnership, and authorization.
Sovereignty became the cohesive maintenance that permits motion without cosmic displacement.
summary.what_was_special: The focus scales one mechanism from moving temporal boundaries and bounded celestial courses to the thinnest seed covering. Context made its verbs operational: gates open and close, calls recruit or fail, terms defer and arrive, and sovereignty both directs motion and holds the system together. Split-root branches preserved turbulent, coercive, boundary-scale, and provision-economy readings without forcing them into the strong models.
remaining_uncertainties: Reciprocal ingress may denote gradual quantitative overlap, a more general exchange, or both.
The celestial term and the human term clearly share wording, but may share only appointment rather than the same ethical function.
The sea, historical-course, and delegated-agency models depend on contextual analogy rather than explicit identity statements.
The split-root outliers are packet-authorized activations but should remain qualified resonances, not primary lexical claims.

baseline.text: Geceyi gündüze katar, gündüzü de geceye katar. Güneşi ve ayı buyruğu altına almıştır; her biri belirlenmiş bir süreye kadar akıp gider. İşte Rabbiniz Allah budur, egemenlik O'nundur. O'nun dışında çağırdıklarınız ise bir çekirdek zarına bile sahip değildir.

findings.text: Gece ile gündüzün düzeni, durağan ayrılıktan çok, sınırları korunarak birbirinin içine giren sürekli ve yönetilen bir alışveriştir.
Egemenlik, en küçük maddi parçayı bile kullanıp yönetebilme ölçüsüyle sınanır ve rakip iddia bu ölçekte dahi başarısız olur.
Allah'ın aşağısında kalanlara yöneltilen çağrı, onları gereken yönetim düzeyine yükseltemeyen bir yakınlaşma girişimi olarak kalır.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.note: Goklerin ve yerin mulkunun Allah'a aitligini, bagislama ve cezalandirma tasarrufuyla birlestirir.

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: medium

inter_ayah_rows.note: Allah'in cagrimina cevap vermemeyi sapiklik ve Allah disinda koruyucu bulamamakla baglar.

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

inter_ayah_rows.label: strong

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Matter or force becomes effective through a controlled relation between opening, channel, boundary, and release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Mercy, rain, and maritime motion acquire a concrete hydraulic architecture of apertures, water-holding cavities, irrigated ground, and channels cut by moving water.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Opening into release
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A closure splits or widens, a latent content erupts, and what was folded or confined spreads into an open course.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: opened closure (quranic:root_001124:B001/m01); water issuing from an outlet (quranic:root_001124:B005/m01); split or fissure (quranic:root_001165:B001/m01); unfolding and branching spread (quranic:root_001503:B001/m01); eruption from quiescence (quranic:root_000210:B001/m01); widening until flow becomes possible (quranic:root_001559:B003/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 35:1 `فَاطِرِ` (ف ط ر); 35:2 `يَفْتَحِ` (ف ت ح); 35:9 `تُثِيرُ/ٱلنُّشُورُ` (ث و ر/ن ش ر); 35:13 `ٱلنَّهَارِ` (ن ه ر).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The opening of mercy is materialized as a breached closure whose contents emerge, spread, and acquire a widened outlet. The resurrection root at 35:9 participates not only in revival but in the physical act of unfolding what had been closed.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Matter or force becomes effective through a controlled relation between opening, channel, boundary, and release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Mercy, rain, and maritime motion acquire a concrete hydraulic architecture of apertures, water-holding cavities, irrigated ground, and channels cut by moving water.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Reservoir, well, and irrigated ground
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water is caught in a depression or rock cavity, retained by a firm boundary, then conducted through soil until the ground is fit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: water-gathering low ground (quranic:root_000086:B006/m01); rock cavity or newly dug well (quranic:root_000434:B011/m01); water-retaining site (quranic:root_001424:B004/m01); river cutting a channel (quranic:root_001559:B001/m01); water sent across soil to improve it (quranic:root_001405:B003/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Retention and release become one irrigation mechanism: a firm cavity first keeps water from vanishing, while a cut channel later distributes it through the land. This gives the opening and withholding of 35:2 a material analogue in managed water.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Matter or force becomes effective through a controlled relation between opening, channel, boundary, and release.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Mercy, rain, and maritime motion acquire a concrete hydraulic architecture of apertures, water-holding cavities, irrigated ground, and channels cut by moving water.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Ship cleaving a moving medium
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A vessel enters flowing water, cuts it under way, and is managed by a water-skilled operator.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: continuous flowing motion (quranic:root_000240:B001/m01); ship circulating on water (quranic:root_001177:B003/m01); hull cleaving water with motion and sound (quranic:root_001405:B001/m01); sailor and navigation craft (quranic:root_001442:B006/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 35:12 `ٱلْفُلْكَ/مَوَاخِرَ/مِلْحٌ` (ف ل ك/م خ ر/م ل ح); 35:13 `يَجْرِى` (ج ر ي).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The visible ships of 35:12 form a complete transport scene: current, vessel, cleaving operation, and operator. The vessel does not merely occupy the sea; it converts resistance into a traversable course.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P1 (35:1-14) Atmospheric Delivery and Vegetal Renewal
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A mobile atmospheric carrier delivers water that reverses terrestrial dormancy into growth and yield.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The resurrection analogy expands into fine-grained plant processes: water-laden cloud mass, returning green in dry herbage, bursting shoots, and tree growth after seasonal recession.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Wind, cloud mass, and rain-bearing transport
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Wind moves through the air, draws a cloud body into view, and carries a layered load whose descent functions as provision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wind and moving air (quranic:root_000609:B003/m01); trailing cloud (quranic:root_000680:B002/m01); water-bearing cloud load (quranic:root_000357:B010/m01); cloud emergence and clearing sky (quranic:root_000400:B005/m01); layered cloud mass (quranic:root_000532:B008/m01); rain descending as provision (quranic:root_000560:B003/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Wind supplies motion, the cloud supplies a carried body, and rain supplies the delivered resource. The cloud is lexically a load and a layered mass, making atmospheric transport structurally parallel to the surah's other acts of sending and carrying.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Meaning moves from disclosure through perception into response, report, or distortion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The scene includes both receptive organs and communication logistics: insight opens an obstruction, news is broadcast, speech returns as an answer, and falsehood is a report diverted from its proper direction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Call, hearing, and returned answer
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A caller directs speech outward; a recipient hears, understands, and causes another to hear; an answer returns along the same communicative path.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: voiced call or summons (quranic:root_000478:B001/m01); auditory reception (quranic:root_000741:B001/m01); understanding and compliance after hearing (quranic:root_000741:B003/m01); causing another to hear (quranic:root_000741:B004/m01); verbal answer (quranic:root_000273:B003/m01); speech returned to its sender (quranic:root_000544:B005/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The failed appeal to the invoked beings is measured against a complete response circuit: call, reception, comprehension, induced hearing, and returned speech. The surface denial removes each functional stage of that circuit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Upward motion becomes a model for increased rank, effective strength, and sovereign command.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Physical elevation and political hierarchy are linked by a shared upward operation, but remain distinct scenes of movement and rule.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Ascent and increasing height
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A body or utterance rises, gains height, and continues upward by increments.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: elevation and upwardness (quranic:root_000745:B001/m01); ascent toward a higher place (quranic:root_000862:B001/m01); increase in height or measure (quranic:root_000862:B008/m01); lifting a body from its place (quranic:root_000582:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The upward route of good speech is materially continuous with bodily ascent and incremental height. The process separates the motion itself from the status that the motion can later signify.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Upward motion becomes a model for increased rank, effective strength, and sovereign command.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Physical elevation and political hierarchy are linked by a shared upward operation, but remain distinct scenes of movement and rule.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rank, dominance, and dominion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An elevated position becomes recognized rank, coercive advantage, effective capacity, and rule over a domain.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: elevation of rank (quranic:root_000582:B002/m01); strength and honor after lowliness (quranic:root_001008:B001/m01); dominance over a rival (quranic:root_001008:B002/m01); kingship and political dominion (quranic:root_001444:B003/m01); effective capacity to act and own (quranic:root_001205:B003/m01); lordship, ownership, and command (quranic:root_000532:B001/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Rank is not treated as a synonym for ascent. It is the social and political outcome produced when elevation becomes capacity, victory, ownership, and stable command.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Value remains productive when goods, payment, and assigned shares circulate; blockage turns circulation into stagnation and loss.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The moral economy is rendered through a literal marketplace with pricing, sale, circulation, wage, and market stagnation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Wage, assigned share, and continuing yield
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Work generates an agreed payment, provision is apportioned, and a continuing grant returns benefit to its recipient.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: wage or recompense for work (quranic:root_000015:B001/m01); fee fixed for a task (quranic:root_000248:B005/m01); apportioned provision (quranic:root_000560:B001/m01); worker's wage or ration (quranic:root_001046:B004/m01); continuing grant or provision (quranic:root_000240:B006/m01)
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Reward is a structured return on action: a task, a fixed fee, an apportioned share, and a continuing flow. The channel keeps payment distinct from botanical yield while preserving their common productive-return invariant.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyin başka bir şeyin içine girmesini, bir şeyi içeri sokmayı ve dar bir yere girmeyi aynı çekirdek çevresinde toplar. Gece ile gündüzün birbirine katılması ise bu çekirdeğin yalnızca belirli bir söz bağlamındaki uzantısıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek anlam giriş ve içeri sokmadır; yakın çevre, giriş yeri, sık girip çıkma, içe işleyen ağrı ve mala ilişkin özel kullanım bu dalın dışında kalır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın giriş çekirdeğini korur; dar yere girme, yinelenen girişler ve gece ile gündüzün birbirine katılması yalnızca kendi biçim ve söz öbekleri kapsamında ele alınır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başka bir şeyin içine girmesi ya da bir şeyin içeri sokulmasıdır. Dar bir geçide girme ve gece ile gündüz sürelerinin birbirine katılarak artması bu çekirdeğin belirli bağlamlardaki gerçekleşmeleridir.

Belirli bir anlatımda gece ile gündüzün her biri ötekine katılarak süresi artırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar giriş anlamında birleşir; içeri sokma, dar bir yere girme ve gece ile gündüzün birbirine katılması da aynı anlam alanında belirtilir.

Bir topluluğa sonradan katılan kişi o topluluktan olmadığı halde onun içinde yer alır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin büyük bölümü kapı, giriş, kum yolu, kuytu arazi, vadi kıvrımı, sığınak ve hayvan ini gibi girilen ya da içeriye götüren yerleri adlandırır. Bal almakta kullanılan kepçeler ise aynı yer çekirdeğini tanımlamaz; yalnızca kaynakta bu adla verilen ayrı bir sözlük karşılığı olarak tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın merkezi giriş, geçit ve korunaklı kuytu yerlerdir; bal kepçesi karşılığı çekirdeğe katılmayan bir kaynak varyantıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, adlaşmış kapı, giriş, yol, kuytu yer ve sığınak biçimlerini ayırır; vadi kıvrımları yalnız kendi söz öbeğinde kalır ve bal kepçesi yalın yer anlamına genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: İçeri geçmeye yarayan kapı, giriş veya yol ile içine girilip saklanılabilen kuytu yer, mağara ya da hayvan inidir; vadi kıvrımları ve kumdaki yol da bu yer ailesine girer. Bal kepçesi karşılığı, yer çekirdeğinden ayrı bir kaynak varyantıdır.

facets.statement: Bir yere içeri geçmeyi sağlayan kapı, giriş noktası ya da yol adlandırılır.
Yolcuların korunabildiği kuytu yer veya mağara ile hayvanların sığındığı in bu aileye girer.
Arazinin ve vadinin kuytu kesimleri, kıvrımları, köşeleri ve yanları giriş yeri ailesiyle adlandırılır.
Kumdaki belirli bir yol, içeri götüren geçit türü olarak adlandırılır.
Aynı adın bal almakta kullanılan kepçeler için verildiği ayrı bir sözlük karşılığı bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak yer alanı kapı, giriş, yol, kuytu arazi, vadi kıvrımı, sığınak ve hayvan inini kapsar; ayrıca yer çekirdeğine uymayan bal kepçesi karşılığı aktarılır.

concept_gloss.text: giriş yeri, kuytu geçit veya sığınak
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın kapı, giriş, yol, kuytu arazi ve korunma yeri çevresindeki ana yer anlamını temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: İçeri götüren yeri ve içine girilerek korunulan kuytu alanı birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir yapının veya arı kovanının içeri geçilen kapısı için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İçeri geçişi sağlayan kapı işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yolcunun hava koşullarından saklandığı mağara veya hayvanın barındığı in için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İçine girilen korunaklı ve kuytu yer işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Vadinin dönemeç, köşe ve kuytu yanlarını bildiren çoğul söz öbeği için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Vadinin kıvrımlı ve kuytu kesimlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca kaynakta verilen ayrı araç adı karşılığında kullanılır; yer anlamına uygulanmaz.

error_profile.preserves: Bal almakta kullanılan kepçe karşılığını bağımsız olarak korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: kapı; özellikle arı kovanının giriş kapısı
yaban hayvanlarının, ceylanların veya yaban sığırlarının ini
yolcuların saklandığı kuytu yer ya da mağara; ağaçlı vadi yeri
yanlar ve yöreler; vadi içindeki kuytu yerlerin çoğulu

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kapı, kum yolu, vadi kıvrımı, hayvan ini ve başka giriş yerlerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle dağdaki doğal mağara ve alçak sığınma yerine bağlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da içine girilerek korunulabilen doğal, kuytu bir yeri adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Mağara anlamında örtüşürler; bu dal giriş ve geçit türlerine yayılırken komşu dal dağdaki doğal oyukla sınırlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yol, kuytu arazi, sığınak, hayvan ini ve vadi kıvrımlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal evin ön avlusunu veya konuta bağlı kapıyı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bir yapıya girişte bulunan kapı veya kapıya bağlı alanı anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal içeri geçilen nokta ve kuytu yer ailesidir; komşu dal konutun kapısı ile ona bitişik ön alana bağlıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yapı kapısını, kum yolunu, vadi kıvrımını ve doğal kuytu yerleri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal çevrilmiş hayvan barınağına, avcı siperine veya sınırlı bir korunağa odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal hayvanın ya da insanın içine girip korunduğu sınırlı bir yeri adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda giriş ve doğal kuytu yer ilişkisi belirleyicidir; komşu dal ise çevrilmiş, barınma amaçlı kapalı alanı öne çıkarır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dalın girişleri ve kuytu yerleri karşı tarafta bir çıkış bulunmasını gerektirmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yer altında ilerleyen ve başka bir çıkışa ulaşan geçit niteliğini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir varlığın içine girip ilerleyebildiği dar bir yol veya geçitle ilgilidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal herhangi bir giriş, yol ya da sığınak olabilir; komşu dalın ayırıcı özelliği yer altından geçip çıkan tünel yapısıdır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal içeri girilen kapı, yol, kuytu yer ve sığınağı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal içeri girme olayını ve bir şeyi içeri sokma işlemini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal aynı içeri geçiş düzeninin yer ve hareket taraflarını paylaşır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal geçişin mekansal dayanağını adlandırır; komşu dal ise sınırı aşma hareketini ve ettirgen biçimini anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün komşular değerlendirildi; seçilen beş aday mağara, kapı çevresi, kapalı barınak, çıkışlı tünel ve giriş eylemi üzerinden yer çekirdeğinin sınırlarını en açık biçimde gösterir.
branches.branch_image_ar: موضع يلج فيه أو غور يستتر به
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الولاج للباب أو باب خلية النحل، والمولج كمدخل، والولجة موضع أو كهف يستتر فيه، والتولج أو الدولج ككناس الوحش، وغوامض الوادي ومعاطفه ونواحيه، والطريق في الرمل، وما سمي ولجا من مغارف العسل.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الوليجة الاجتماعية، ولا فعل الولوج نفسه إلا من جهة اسم المكان، ولا وجع الوالجة.
branches.source_phrase_ar: الولج الطريق في الرمل (maqayis)؛ الولاج الباب والمولج المدخل والتولج الكناس والولاج الغامض من الأرض والوادي (jamhara)؛ الولجة موضع أو كهف تستتر فيه المارة والتولج كناس الوحش (sihah)؛ أولاج الوادي معاطفه وزواياه والولجة مكان من الوادي والولج أيضا مغارف العسل (tahdhib)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnız belirli kişi nitelemelerinde sık sık içeri girip dışarı çıkmayı, bir varyantta da işlere girip onlardan çıkmayı anlatır. Bu nedenle dal bağımsız bir giriş anlamı değil, iki yönlü ve yinelenen davranış niteliğidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam, sık girip çıkan kişiyi bildiren sabit nitelemelerle sınırlıdır; tek bir giriş veya tek bir çıkış bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız kişi için kullanılan iki parçalı nitelemelere bağlıdır; buradan yalın kök için genel bir sıklık ya da hareket anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli kişi nitelemelerinde, bir kimsenin çok sık içeri girip dışarı çıkmasıdır; bir anlatımda kişinin işlere girip sonra onlardan çıkması da bu iki yönlü davranışla ifade edilir.

facets.statement: Kişi çok sık içeri girer ve dışarı çıkar.
Bir varyantta kişi işlerin içine girip sonra onlardan çıkan biri olarak nitelenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, iki parçalı kişi nitelemesinin sık girip çıkmayı bildirdiğinde birleşir; bir anlatım bu davranışı işlere girip çıkma olarak özelleştirir.

concept_gloss.text: sık sık girip çıkan veya işlere girip çıkan kimse
concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnız kişiyi iki yönlü ve yinelenen giriş çıkış davranışıyla niteleyen söz öbekleri için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kişiyi, sıklığı ve giriş ile çıkışın birlikte bulunmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir yere tekrar tekrar girip oradan çıkmasını anlatan nitelemede kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yinelenen giriş ve çıkışı kişi niteliği olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin işlerin içine girip ardından onlardan çıktığını bildiren özel varyantta kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İşlere katılma ve onlardan ayrılma yönlerini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: çok sık dışarı çıkıp içeri giren adam

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal giriş ile çıkışın birlikte yinelenmesini ve kişide süreklilik gösteren bir nitelik olmasını gerektirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal tek bir içeri giriş olayını veya bir şeyi içeri sokmayı da anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişinin veya varlığın içeri girme hareketini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal yalnız sabit kişi nitelemesinde sık ve iki yönlü hareketi bildirir; komşu dalın çekirdeği tek başına giriş eylemidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal işlere girmeye ek olarak onlardan çıkmayı, sıklığı ve kişi niteliğini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız bir işe girme eylemini bildirir ve çıkış ya da tekrar koşulu taşımaz.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişinin bir işin içine katılması anlamında örtüşebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: İş bağlamında yakınlaşırlar; ancak bu dal giriş ve çıkışın eşleştiği kalıcı bir kişi niteliğidir, komşu dal tek yönlü eylemdir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal çıkıştan sonra yeniden giriş yönünü, tekrarı ve kişi nitelemesini de içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir yerden başka yere hareket etme veya çıkıp yol alma olayına odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda da bir kişinin bulunduğu yerden dışarı çıkması yer alabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal çıkış ve yolculuk yönündedir; bu dal çıkışı girişle eşleyip sık yinelenen bir davranış olarak sunar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal giriş ve çıkışın sık tekrarlanmasını yalnız kişi nitelemesinde bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal ilerleme, yaşa veya döneme girme ve yol alma gibi çok çeşitli tek yönlü süreçleri kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda da bir alana veya duruma girme hareketi bulunabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal çift yönlü tekrar ve kişi niteliğiyle sınırlıdır; komşu dal girişten sonra ilerleyen daha geniş süreçleri anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; yayımlanan dört karşılaştırma yalın giriş, işe girme, çıkıp gitme ve içeri ilerleme sınırlarını açıklar, diğer adaylar yalnız biçimsel sıklık veya uzak hareket çağrışımı taşır.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رجل خرجة ولجة أو خراج ولاج: الكثير الخروج والدخول أو الداخل في الأمور والخارج منها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الدخول المفرد، ولا الوليجة بمعنى البطانة، ولا مواضع الدخول.
branches.source_phrase_ar: رجل خرجة ولجة كثير الخروج والولوج (maqayis)؛ رجل خراج ولاج للذي يدخل في الأمور ويخرج منها (jamhara)؛ رجل خرجة ولجة كثير الخروج والدخول (sihah)؛ رجل خرجة ولجة كثير الخروج والولوج (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin bir bölümü ağrıyı insanın iç boşluğuna işleyen bir rahatsızlık olarak açıkça tanımlar, diğer bölümü ise yalnız insanı tutan ağrı der. Bu nedenle içe işleme görüntüsü dalı iyi temsil eder, fakat her kullanımda kesin bir organ veya yalnız karın bölgesi varsayılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, insanı tutan ve özellikle iç boşluğa işlediği düşünülen ağrı adıdır; genel hastalık, boğaz ağrısı veya yaralanma anlamına genişletilmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, iki ad biçiminin doğrudan ağrı anlamını verir; komşu hastalık adlarından veya söz öbeklerinden ek bir organ ve belirti koşulu alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: İnsanı tutan, özellikle bedenin iç boşluğuna işlediği düşünülen bir ağrıdır. Kaynak ifadesi kesin bir organı her durumda belirtmez.

facets.statement: Ağrı insanı tutar ve ona rahatsızlık verir.
Ağrı bedenin iç boşluğuna giren veya içeri işleyen bir ağrı olarak tasarlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bunun insanı tutan bir ağrı adı olduğunda birleşir; daha ayrıntılı açıklama ağrının insanın iç boşluğuna işlediğini belirtir.

concept_gloss.text: insanı tutan, iç boşluğa işleyen ağrı
concept_gloss.applicability: Belirli bir organı zorunlu kılmadan, insanı tutan ve bedene içten işlediği düşünülen ağrı için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Ağrı olmasını, insanı tutmasını ve iç boşluğa işleme niteliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ağrının bedenin iç boşluğuna doğru girdiğinin düşünüldüğü açıklamada kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ağrının iç boşluğa doğru işleme görüntüsünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ağrının yeri ayrıca belirtilmeden yalnız kişiyi etkilediği genel açıklamada kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ağrının kişiyi etkileyip tutmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal özellikle ağrıyı adlandırır ve onu iç boşluğa işleyen bir duyum olarak sunar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal iç organları tutan daha genel bir hastalık adı ve kişiyi bütünüyle kaplayan rahatsızlık görüntüsü taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal insanın iç boşluğunu etkileyen bir rahatsızlığı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal ağrı türüdür; komşu dal ağrıdan daha geniş bir hastalık kavramı taşır ve kişiyi kaplama görüntüsüyle açıklanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal iç boşluğa işleme görüntüsünü taşır ve her kullanımda karnı açıkça belirtmez.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal rahatsızlığın yerini doğrudan karın olarak sınırlar ve onu hastalık olarak da adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bedenin iç kısmında duyulan ve kişiyi tutan ağrıyı anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal karın bölgesine bağlıdır; bu dalın kanıtı daha geniş bir iç boşluk ve içe işleme tasarımına izin verir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ağrının iç boşluğa girip işlemesi biçimindeki açıklamayı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız karındaki belirli bir ağrının özel adı olarak verilir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal insanın beden içindeki ağrısını, özellikle karın çevresinde yorumlanabilecek bir rahatsızlığı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal belirli bir karın ağrısı adıyla sınırlıdır; bu dal ise içeri işleyen ağrı görüntüsüyle tanımlanır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal insanı tutan belirli bir ağrı adını ve iç boşluğa işleme niteliğini taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal hastalık, ağrıdan yakınma, hasta kişi ve ağrıyan organ gibi daha geniş bir söz alanını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal bedensel rahatsızlık ve ağrı alanında yer alır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal belirli bir ağrı türüdür; komşu dal hastalık ve yakınma süreçlerini de içeren geniş bir alandır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yeri kesinleşmemiş biçimde iç boşluğa işleyen ağrıyı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yalnız boğazda bulunan ağrıyı adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bedende duyulan bir ağrı türünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ortaklık yalnız ağrı alanındadır; komşu dal boğaza özgüdür, bu dal ise genel iç boşluk ve içe işleme ilişkisine dayanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar değerlendirildi; yayımlanan karşılaştırmalar iç organ rahatsızlığı, karın ağrısı, genel hastalık ve boğaz ağrısı sınırlarını gösterir, diğerleri farklı organlara veya yaralanma süreçlerine daha uzaktır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الولوج الحركي، ولا الوليجة للبطانة، ولا أسماء مواضع الدخول.
